model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port :in Event :as keep) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port :out Snapshot :as metric) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (adjacent
      (block ShadowQueue
        (implements Durable)
        (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
      (block LocalSync :type "Service"
        (port :in Command :as evt)
        (port :out Command)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block ShadowSession
        (port :in Event)
        (port :out Request)
        (implements Durable)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
        (level
          (adjacent
            (block Pricing :type "Store"
              (port :in Event :as evt)
              (implements Durable)
              (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
            (block EdgeInbox
              (port :in Event :as req)
              (port :out Command)
              (implements Observable)
              (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))))
        (level
          (block Audit :type "Feature"
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
          (block LocalBilling :type "Process"
            (port :in Request :as req)
            (port :out Event :as done)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
            (level
              (block RemoteGateway
                (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
              (adjacent
                (block EdgeSync
                  (port :in Snapshot :as req)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
                (block Router
                  (port :in Request)
                  (implements Observable)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                (block ShadowEditor :type "Feature"
                  (port :in Request)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
            (level
              (block EdgeCatalog
                (port :in Event)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
              (block ShadowBilling
                (port :in Snapshot :as req)
                (implements Durable)
                (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))))))
      (block RemoteUploader
        (port :in Request :as req)
        (port :out Request)
        (implements Observable)
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
        (level
          (block RetryAudit
            (port :in Receipt)
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
          (adjacent
            (block BatchParser
              (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
              (level
                (adjacent
                  (block EdgeSession
                    (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                  (block BatchBilling
                    (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))
                (adjacent
                  (block ShadowScheduler
                    (implements Observable)
                    (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                  (block RetryPlanner
                    (port :in Request :as evt)
                    (port :out Receipt)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block Ledger :type "Service"
                    (port :in Request :as evt)
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))))
            (block BatchFeed :type "Feature"
              (implements Observable)
              (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
              (level
                (block BatchCatalog :type "Process"
                  (port :in Request :as req)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block LiveAuth :type "Service"
                  (port :in Snapshot :as evt)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
                (block LiveLedger :type "Process"
                  (port :out Command :as done)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
            (block Search
              (port :out Event)
              (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")
              (level
                (block Auth
                  (port :in Command)
                  (implements Observable)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (adjacent
                  (block RetryInbox
                    (port :out Request)
                    (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                  (block RetryRouter
                    (port :in Event)
                    (port :out Event :as done)
                    (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                  (block RetryGateway :type "Feature"
                    (port :in Receipt)
                    (port :out Snapshot :as emit)
                    (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
                  (block Sync
                    (port :in Event :as evt)
                    (implements Observable)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))))
              (level
                (adjacent
                  (block LocalRouter :type "Process"
                    (port :in Snapshot :as req)
                    (port :out Request :as done)
                    (implements Durable)
                    (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
                  (block RetryScheduler
                    (port :in Receipt :as evt)
                    (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))
                (adjacent
                  (block LiveSearch
                    (port :out Command :as emit)
                    (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                  (block RemoteFeed
                    (port :in Receipt :as req)
                    (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind.")))))))
        (level
          (block LocalMetrics
            (port :in Receipt)
            (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
          (block RetrySync
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
          (block Billing
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))))
  (level
    (adjacent
      (block RetryEditor
        (port :out Request :as done)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block LiveSync
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Profile
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))
    (block RetrySession :type "Feature"
      (port :in Snapshot :as evt)
      (port :out Receipt :as emit)
      (implements Durable)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
